description: A React component for rendering and managing a 'fill-in-the-blank' challenge in a learning platform, including state management, user input handling, and integration with Redux and GraphQL.

classes.name: ShowFillInTheBlank
classes.description: React functional component for displaying and handling a fill-in-the-blank challenge, including user input, validation, and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleSubmitNonChinese
methods.description: Handles submission and answer validation for non-Chinese language challenges.

methods.name: handleSubmitChinese
methods.description: Handles submission and answer validation for Chinese language challenges, including pinyin and hanzi matching.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Determines which submit handler to call based on challenge language.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates user answers and validation state when user inputs change.
